boards.name: Boards and kitchen
boards.description: Cutting and serving boards, spatulas and stands in oak, walnut and beech. We engrave names, dates and recipes.

leather.name: Leather
leather.description: Wallets, covers, belts and keychains in vegetable-tanned leather. Embossing and laser engraving.

watches.name: Watches and accessories
watches.description: Wrist and pocket watches, cufflinks and tie clips with an engraved lid.

office.name: Office and notebooks
office.description: Notebooks, pens, stands and organisers for the desk with your logo or initials.

decor.name: Home decor
decor.description: Signs, frames, key holders and night lights that make a home yours.

drinkware.name: Glasses, flasks, mugs
drinkware.description: Glass, steel and ceramics: wine glasses, flasks, travel mugs and mugs with engraving.

boxes.name: Gift boxes
boxes.description: Gift sets we put together. Want to swap something? Write to us and we will build one for you.

fillings.name: Box fillings
fillings.description: Honey, coffee, tea, chocolate and candles from small makers. Add them to your box.

dubovyi-dvir.name: Dubovyi Dvir
dubovyi-dvir.story: A two-person joinery. They dry their own oak and walnut, so the boards do not warp even after years of washing.

paliturnia.name: Podil Bindery
paliturnia.story: They started by binding diplomas and now hand-sew notebooks and leather goods with waxed thread.

hart.name: Hart
hart.story: A small metal shop. Flasks, cufflinks and signs in stainless steel that never tarnishes.

sklo-verkhovyny.name: Verkhovyna Glass
sklo-verkhovyny.story: They blow glass by hand, so every glass differs a little from its neighbour.

hlynianyi-hlek.name: Clay Jug
hlynianyi-hlek.story: Third-generation potters. Mugs and plates from local clay with a food-safe glaze.

bort.name: Bort
bort.story: An apiary of 120 hives by the Southern Bug. The honey is never heated or blended.

obsmazhka-14.name: Obsmazhka 14
obsmazhka-14.story: A micro-roastery. They roast small batches every Friday, so the coffee arrives fresh.

chainyi-lyst.name: Tea Leaf
chainyi-lyst.story: They blend herbal teas from Carpathian herbs and buy loose-leaf tea from small farms.

kakao-bib.name: Cocoa Bean
kakao-bib.story: Bean-to-bar chocolate: they roast the cocoa beans and temper the chocolate by hand.

teplyi-visk.name: Warm Wax
teplyi-visk.story: Candles from soy and beeswax with cotton wicks, no paraffin.

mitka.name: Mitka Workshop
mitka.story: Our own laser workshop. This is where we engrave everything you order and pack the boxes.
